Below, we’ll walk through 20 of the most liked Instagram posts so far and what made each one so compelling.

## ****The most liked posts on Instagram in 202**** 6

Ready to see the posts that made almost everyone stop scrolling and double‑tap? Get comfortable; we’re going through the moments that pulled in huge global attention.

### **Messi’s Celebration After the World Cup Victory**

**Number of likes: 75.7 million**

Lionel Messi’s post celebrating Argentina’s victory over France in the 2022 FIFA World Cup holds the record for the most liked image on Instagram, with roughly 75 million likes as of the last verification. The carousel shows Messi lifting the World Cup trophy surrounded by teammates and fans, with the caption “CAMPEONES DEL MUNDO!!!!!!” (“Champions of the world”).

It’s not just another trophy photo.
For many fans, it marked the final chapter in Messi’s long chase for a World Cup, and it quickly became the most liked social media post of all time, not only on Instagram.

### ****The world‑record egg****

**Number of likes: 60.2 million**

Before Messi’s World Cup post took over, a simple photo of a brown egg, nothing else, no celebrity, no fancy caption, held the record for the most liked Instagram post. The account @world\_record\_egg was created purely to beat Kylie Jenner’s then‑record, and it worked: the egg shot past 50 million likes and kept going into the 60‑million range.

The viral success of the egg proved how powerful community‑driven jokes and challenges can be. People enjoyed the absurdity of it, and for years it stood as a kind of in‑joke about social media itself.

### ****Messi in bed with the World Cup trophy****

**Number of likes: 54.7 million**

In this post, Messi is lying in bed with the World Cup trophy, smiling, holding the cup close, and sipping mate.

...

The whole setup was staged, there was no real match, but the symbolism of their rivalry and mutual respect made the image unforgettable.

### ****Messi relaxing on the plane with the World Cup trophy****

****Number of likes:** around 42 million**

Another Messi post from the same World Cup run shows him on a plane, smiling and cradling the trophy in his seat. It’s one of those “quiet after the chaos” photos, and it quickly crossed the 40‑million‑like mark.

Fans loved the simplicity: no big stadium, no fireworks, just Messi and the trophy, finally heading home after years of chasing this moment.

### ****Messi celebrates back in Argentina****

****Number of likes: around 34.7 million****

When Argentina returned home, Messi shared photos from the celebrations with fans in Buenos Aires. The images of him with the trophy and crowds packed into the streets gathered tens of millions of likes, landing this post in the top twenty.

...

The announcement also drew global attention to Saudi football and highlighted a growing trend of star players taking high‑profile moves outside Europe’s traditional big leagues.

### **Ronaldo’s post after Portugal’s World Cup elimination**

****Number of likes: around 34.2 million****

After Portugal was knocked out of the 2022 World Cup by Morocco, Ronaldo posted a reflective, emotional message on Instagram that resonated strongly with fans. The image and caption together gathered over 30 million likes.

Unlike celebratory posts, this one showed disappointment and vulnerability. Many fans and fellow players responded with support, and the post became one of the most‑liked non‑victory posts on Instagram.

### ****XXXTentacion’s final post****

****Number of likes: around 32.8 million****

The last Instagram post from rapper XXXTentacion, a simple blank white image, became a memorial after his death and has amassed tens of millions of likes.

...

For many fans, it felt like a last chance to see the two icons competing in the same match, and the post captured that sense of nostalgia and excitement.

### ****Tom Holland’s birthday post for Zendaya****

****Number of likes: around 26.3 million****

On Zendaya’s birthday, Tom Holland posted a sweet photo of her with the caption, “My MJ, have the happiest of birthdays. Gimme a call when you’re up xxx.” The post climbed past 25 million likes.

Fans already loved the couple from the Spider‑Man films, and this quiet, affectionate post gave people exactly the kind of personal moment they like to see from celebrities.

### ****Messi’s tribute to Pelé****

****Number of likes:** around 26.0 million**

Lionel Messi also shared a tribute to Pelé, posting photos and a message thanking him for his legacy in football. The post quickly reached the mid‑20‑million range in likes.

**Breaking into the top 20 most-liked posts on Instagram is really impressive. With over [3 billion monthly users](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/09/24/instagram-now-has-3-billion-monthly-active-users.html) spending [33 minutes daily](https://metricool.com/important-instagram-statistics/) on the platform, that’s serious competition.**

So what does it take? A massive following helps (check out who has [the most Instagram followers](https://www.brandwatch.com/blog/top-most-instagram-followers/) ). It also doesn’t hurt to have great photography skills. And having something worth capturing matters too – though as you'll see in this list, the rules aren't as rigid as you might think.

Spoiler alert: Lionel Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo dominate the list with 12 out of the top 20 most-liked posts.

Let's dive in.

## 20\. Ronaldo honors Pelè

Cristiano Ronaldo opens this list with a tribute to Pelé, one of football's greatest players, following his death in 2022.

...

Winning the World Cup is the highest achievement for professional football players, so it’s not surprising that Messi posing with the trophy attracted a phenomenal amount of likes.The carousel features photos and a video of Argentina’s team bus parading through the streets of Buenos Aires – and iconic moment not just for Messi but the country.

This was the last post from rapper XXXTentacion before his death in June 2018.

Eerily, a music video was released posthumously in which the rapper attends his own funeral.

Messi's November 9, 2025 visit to Barcelona's Camp Nou produced an emotional Instagram post that captured hearts worldwide. The 38-year-old shared images from his surprise visit with a caption hoping to "return for the goodbye I never got to say as a player."

The post referenced his sudden 2021 exit from Barcelona after 21 years due to the club's financial crisis – a departure made even more painful by COVID restrictions that prevented a proper farewell. Barcelona now plans to honor him with a statue at Camp Nou, though Messi recently extended his Inter Miami contract through 2028.

# Our Most “Liked” Instagram Posts of 2017

Our Instagram page has over 2,200 images and is lucky enough to be followed by more than 29 million fans.

What images and videos were your favorite from this past year? Great question, and one we asked ourselves too!

## Here’s a look at our most liked Instagram posts\* of 2017…Enjoy!

## **\#10 Black Hole Collision**

What happens when [two supermassive black holes collide](https://www.instagram.com/p/Bb5Fj4jH-m7/?taken-by=nasa#) ? Until last year, we weren’t quite sure. Gravitational waves! With **834,169 likes** , this image is our 10th most liked of 2017.

## **\#9 Italy Through the Space Station Cupola Window**

European astronaut Paolo Nespoli ( [@Astro\_Paolo](https://twitter.com/astro_paolo/status/925807147576897536) ) shared this image on social media of " [Southern #Italy and Sicily](https://www.instagram.

...

com/p/BcnwMzwnUDw/) captures the location of several vital elements like silicon (red), sulfur (yellow), calcium (green) and iron (purple), located on Cassiopeia A--a supernova remnant ~11,000 light years from Earth. This image ranks #7 for 2017 with **943,806 likes** .

## **\#6 Jupiter Blues**

Jupiter, you’re bluetiful 💙 ! [Churning swirls of Jupiter’s clouds](https://www.instagram.com/p/BcPvPGGnnm5) are seen in striking shades of blue in this new view taken by our Juno spacecraft. This image ranks as our sixth most liked Instagram post of 2017 with **990,944 likes** .

## **\#5 An Interstellar Visitor**

[An interstellar visitor](https://www.instagram.com/p/Bbu66LDHdEo/) …scientists have confirmed that an intriguing asteroid that zipped through our solar system in October is the first confirmed object from another star!
Observations suggest that this unusual object had been wandering through the Milky Way, unattached to any star system, for hundreds of millions of years before its chance encounter with our star system. With **1,015,721 likes** , this image ranks #5 for 2017.

## **\#4 Space Station Lunar Transit**

[Space station supermoon](https://www.instagram.com/p/BcQgmsxHtaM/) . This composite image made from six frames shows the International Space Station, with a crew of six onboard, as it transits the Moon at roughly five miles per second on Dec. 2. This image ranks #4 for 2017 with **1,037,520 likes** .

## **\#3 The Space Between Us**

> [A post shared by NASA (@nasa)](https://www.instagram.com/p/Bc8Q0tCnMOh/) on Dec 20, 2017 at 2:56pm PST

[The beautiful space](https://www.instagram.com/p/Bc8Q0tCnMOh/) between Earth and the International Space Station was immortalized by NASA astronaut Mark Vande Hei while orbiting 250 miles above the planet we call home.
This majestic image ranks #3 for 2017 with **1,042,403 likes** .

## **\#2 The Moon Swallows the Sun**

> [A post shared by NASA (@nasa)](https://www.instagram.com/p/BYEfvA8BPLy/) on Aug 21, 2017 at 2:03pm PDT

Today, the Sun disappeared, seemingly swallowed by our Moon–at least for a while. The August 21 solar eclipse cut through a swath of North America from coast to coast and those along the path of totality, that is where the Moon completely covered the Sun, were faced with a sight unseen in the U.S. in 99 years. Which might have something to do with this image ranking #2 for 2017 with **1,144,503 likes.**

## **\#1 Solar Eclipse Over Cascade Lake**

> [A post shared by NASA (@nasa)](https://www.instagram.com/p/BYEswcABpQZ/) on Aug 21, 2017 at 3:57pm PDT

Behold! This progression of the partial solar eclipse took place over Ross Lake, in Northern Cascades National Park, Washington on Monday, Aug. 21, 2017.

This photo was our #1 image of 2017 with **1,471,114 likes** !
